defects.description: The fall from 33% (1970) to 12% (2015) is called 'a decline of 31 percentage points', but 33 - 12 = 21 percentage points.
paraphrases: 33 minus 12 is 21, not the stated 31 percentage points.
The percentage-point decline is miscalculated (should be 21).
The drop from 33% to 12% does not equal 31 points.
defects.rationale: Correct value '21 percentage points' (33 - 12). Findable from the two rates in the same passage, distinct.

defects.description: Hunger is described as having 'more than doubled' over the period, but the rate fell from 33% to 12% — it decreased, so it cannot have doubled.
paraphrases: The rate went down (33% to 12%), so 'more than doubled' is the wrong direction.
A decline from 33% to 12% is a fall, not a doubling.
'More than doubled' contradicts the reported decrease in the hunger rate.
defects.rationale: Correct phrasing 'more than halved' (12 < 33/2). Findable from the 33%-to-12% fall stated in the same passage, distinct.

defects.description: The 1970 rate is described as 'one-in-four ... about 33%', but one-in-four is 25%, not 33%.
paraphrases: One-in-four is 25%, which does not match the stated 33%.
The fraction and the percentage disagree: one-in-four is not about 33%.
'One-in-four' should be 'one-in-three' to match the 33% figure.
defects.rationale: Correct phrasing 'one-in-three' (~33%). Findable from the fraction and the 33% in the same sentence, distinct from the other defects.
